title: TopoTTA: Topology-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Tubular Structure Segmentation
mechanism: Test-time adaptation for thin structures: topological meta difference convolutions adapt without changing pretrained weights, then pseudo-break hard samples with prediction alignment restore continuity.
adaptation: Aims at E1 (half-cut, scuff). Adapt on unlabelled pool half-cells (1,152 multi half-cells), not on E1. Weak where 70% of E1 crack pixels get p < 0.001, because the pseudo-breaks need partial detection.
min_experiment: Arm: PF ensemble + TopoTTA on pool half-cells. Baseline: PF ensemble. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03.
evidence: R (abstract): 4 scenarios, 10 datasets, average clDice +31.81% under domain shift. Code only via an anonymous link (unverified).
prior_overlap: Per-panel BN adaptation (a TTA) failed. TopoTTA uses different machinery (difference convolutions plus topology hard samples), so it is open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Adapt on the 1,152 unlabelled half-cut multi cells from the pool instead of on E1, so E1 stays a clean test. Difference convolutions may separate thin dark cracks from wider scuff streaks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: TopoTTA-style adaptation of the PF ensemble members on pool half-cuts vs the unadapted PF ensemble. Metrics: E1 crack IoU and recall, E1 inactive. Kill if E1 crack recall gains < 0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Adapt the trained PF model on unlabelled CSIR multi half-cut pool cells (same source family as E1, not E1 itself), then score E1 once.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + TopoTTA on 1,152 half-cut pool cells; baseline PF ensemble. Metric E1 crack relF1@2 and recall. Kill: E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Put the difference-conv adapters in the U-Net++ decoder only. Pseudo-breaks: mask 5 to 15 px segments of predicted crack skeletons on E1 cells and align predictions on these hard samples. This targets fragmented crack predictions on scuffed half-cuts. It needs our own implementation.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SUP100-PF + TopoTTA adapters per E1 module. Baseline: SUP100-PF. Metrics: E1 component recall and relF1@2, with test crack IoU as a guard. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gains < +0.02 or test crack IoU drops by 0.005.
